summary: Accept frozen E4607 protocol together with the separately recorded root-requested minimality amendment. Exact source/input pins match; saved schema confirms all12 rows/all60 slots/42 observed/18 unknown and the frozen null/association pattern. Existing pairedEdges operation supports the software cross-contract falsifier; no existing adapter audit already compares these descriptor outputs to saved scalar offsets. No scientific or consumer-defect inference is admitted, and no geometry/tests were run for this review.

amendment.authority: Root PM explicit pre-execution minimality decision accepted by S3
amendment.effect: Do not duplicate unchanged1.8MB original payload in result.evidence. Keep a disclosed complete audit-field projection plus authoritative original path/bytes/hash/source-base and raw-context JSON pointers; originalinputhash must be verified before/after. No oracle, tolerance, roster or scientific-boundary change.

review_checks.roster: Exactly12 frozen rows, five ordered slots per row;42 OBSERVED and18 UNKNOWN. Every row's slot/rawStation station/frame association matches and a unique rawStations candidate at row.widthPx exactly matches slot.rawCandidate.
review_checks.null_missing: All18 UNKNOWN saved slots have literal null midpoint/left/right geometry. Per branch lateral42 missing1; lateral50 missing1,2,4,5; bright50 missing1,2,3,4. Isolation, reasons and failures retained; no zero/imputation/gap bridging.
review_checks.operation_contract: One describePath call per row using all five saved origins and aligned observed edge pairs/nulls. Existing code returns centerline.samples, observedPairs, midpoint, fitted fullWidthPx, Euclidean distance and fitted-width ratio. No new geometry equations, width/support inputs, countTurns or producer execution required.
review_checks.call_accounting: Exactly12 attempted actual calls after successful admission, once each. Per-row error retained and remaining rows attempted once; no retry. Pre-admission refusal has zero geometry calls. Counters/descriptors/errors are not substituted by fixtures.
review_checks.normalization: Nonnegative returned distanceInFullWidths compares against abs(saved pixel offset)/saved fitted edgeFit.wPx. Signed saved nominal-width42/50 ratio is retained separately and never treated as the fitted denominator.
review_checks.frames: Named crop/source frames and [400,1010] relation retained. Cross-branch comparisons are dependent representation/custody checks, not a second course or physical validation.
review_checks.nonduplication: Existing window recipe never passes pairedEdges to describePath. Existing adapter tests check midpoint projection and missing-run behavior, not descriptor-to-saved-scalar consistency. Existing compareFrames checks translated representations but not this pair/scalar seam. Saved offset observable itself is already present and is not new.
review_checks.falsifier: Any above1e-9 residual, frame/association/roster/state/count discrepancy, malformed required data or unexpected operation error is retained as inconsistency/error/refusal. Complete one-pass evidence is retained before STOP; no repair, tolerance change or rerun. This can reject coordinate/scalar association coherence without claiming physical truth.
review_checks.custody: Exact original tracked bytes authoritative; before/after input/dependency/new-source hashes, fixed commands, fresh exclusive outputs and same captured result for reporting retained. Amendment removes redundant payload copy only; complete audit fields and raw-context pointers remain mandatory.
review_checks.firstgreen: Expected FIRSTGREEN is honest: neither missing module nor protocol proposal is RED. No observed current consumer failure is claimed. Narrow adapter fixtures do not call the actual saved audit and are not physical evidence.
review_checks.review_execution: One author actual pass is sufficient absent a fresh failure; reviewer does not duplicate geometry. Actual implementation must still present written flow and stop at checkpoint before any test/geometry execution.
review_checks.blindness_and_hold: Symmetric left/right swap is undetectable by midpoint/width/absolute-offset comparisons. Inputs share the same fit, labels are exposed and widths uncalibrated. Path/edge identity, fit correctness, support, AA, continuity, ownership, confidence, causality and generalization remain UNKNOWN/HOLD.

scope_of_acceptance: Protocol plus identified amendment only, not implementation acceptance, run authorization, a passing actual audit or physical evidence. Root admission and written-flow checkpoint remain required.
